pages.text: Soul Fragments are opened in the abilities window (last line of the last page). Initially there are none. The Nth Fragment costs N experience levels. The maximum is set by the config $(thing)soulShardMax$().

If you die while Ghost Instincts are active and possess at least one Shard, black smoke appears at the spot of your death, preserving all your items along with their original positions.$(br2)Right-click the smoke to restore your items to their places. The number of active Shards corresponds to the number you have unlocked; newer Shards replace the oldest ones. Only the owner can retrieve the items.
